purpose: Incremental source-game reconstruction into useful reusable wired game-system phases. No generated game, ROM, demo or whole-game readiness claim.

ownership.workers: Write only your private game prefab-pass directory. Do not edit central src/, API allowlists, ontology indexes or another game's artifacts.
ownership.semanticLead: Owns blueprint definitions, candidate integration, role eligibility and canonical reusable module identity.
ownership.compilerIntake: Owns publication of changed/new qualified package contracts and current immutable pins.
ownership.siteOwner: Owns the exact prefab ID/path allowlist and frontend packaging.
ownership.uiOwner: Owns ready-prefab add/configure/reuse flow. One module instance across its role facets; no copied actor/world state.

sourceSystemIds: existing normalized source ID; omit only when exact sourceContractRef is supplied
blueprintIds: one or more blueprint IDs below

coreLoop.playerOutcome: Recognizable core experience for this source game.

edges.scope: Actual source boundary; not a guessed total frame schedule.

missingForCoreGame: Specific missing consumer, producer, runtime service or lifecycle boundary; do not say only full game missing.

bundles.label: Useful system phase
bundles.sourceContractRef: exact existing packet when no normalized source ID exists

prefabs.label: Useful source phase

inputs.label: Meaningful setting
inputs.binding: canonical state slot or invocation argument

phases.trigger: source event or explicit supplied host event

prefabs.qualificationScope: Symbolic binding/lowering only unless a separately retained execution receipt proves more.

timing.accounting: Nested stages identified; unavailable metrics remain null, not zero.

qualityGates: Deliver1–3 useful actual wired assemblies when existing qualification supports them. Source-only reconstruction is honest when closure is blocked; do targeted closure work rather than fabricate a graph.
A single source routine may be a useful coherent transaction. Do not pad it with unrelated calls to make it multi-function.

Bind real observable outputs. Never discard a predicate return and claim its consumer is connected. Never clear geometry before its intended consumer unless describing an explicit separate cleanup phase.

Use current published immutable package/behavior pins and actual tools/behavior_ir/assembly.py validation. Newly lowered code or native source modules are not automatically published portable prefabs.
Keep canonical actor/world/session state and original aliasing, result capture, invocation/phase order and source domains. Explicit host schedules may be useful but must say caller-declared.
No arbitrary same-type wiring, source order guessed from addresses, invented service stubs, fresh gameplay logic, unsafe domain widening or automatic cross-game compatibility.
A facet describes exactly what the module supplies to that role. Ground/contact inputs do not prove a terrain producer; lethal flags do not close death/drop; held input does not grant an ability.
Publish one delivery manifest per game; keep independently valid prefab entries so central integration can accept useful pieces immediately without waiting for all fleet games.
Reuse existing receipts; run only narrow graph/host checks for newly added connections. No broad campaigns/native reruns without a specific unresolved behavior reason.

Product acceptance is separate from schema/Composer validity. Bookkeeping-only reset, initializer, getter/setter or predicate artifacts without a meaningful connected game responsibility stay internalSupportPhases and are not primary ready prefabs. No forced numeric quota.

A core phase may use status internal-consumed with parentPrefabIds only when a registered useful parent prefab actually implements it. It is not an independently addable module or missing standalone capability. Unconnected reset/init/query proof remains internalSupportPhases, never implicit parent coverage.
